events.event: The DPR and government agreed to take the Perampasan Aset (asset forfeiture) bill to a plenary session on Thursday 19 November to be passed into law.
events.key_numbers: 397 DIM discussed, agreed 5 Nov 2026 (160 fixed, 135 wording, 40 substantive, 44 deleted, 18 new) · plenary Thu 19 Nov 2026 · Komisi III approved timus/timsin report 18 Nov
events.why_it_matters: A long-stalled law that lets the state seize suspected illicit assets without waiting for a criminal conviction is finally being passed.
events.spreading_evidence: Top-news ANTARA #2; CNBC Indonesia lists 3 items (#12, #20, #24); CNN Indonesia #15 and #19

events.event: Bareskrim raided a house in Cipete, South Jakarta and several other locations suspected of serving as a makar (treason) command post linked to Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso (EHS) in the presidential wiretapping case.
events.key_numbers: raid 18 Nov 2026 · location Cipete, South Jakarta
events.why_it_matters: The case of a former police chief allegedly tapping the president has escalated from wiretapping to a treason (makar) angle.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA Pilihan Editor; Okezone, Viva, Suara Surabaya, Berita Satu, Jpnn all covered it same day

events.event: The Palace said Prabowo's inner circle is 'sterile' of Listyo's people and showed off its cyber-security team, while Bakom claimed attacks on Prabowo on social media fell after Listyo's arrest.
events.key_numbers: Details not verified beyond headlines (full articles not opened)
events.why_it_matters: Shows how the government is framing the fallout of the wiretapping case.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional top 3 items on 18 Nov

events.event: Support for Gerindra's Sufmi Dasco Ahmad as the new vice president to replace Gibran keeps growing (senators and Gerindra branches), while CNN Indonesia analysed why coalition parties are reluctant to fill the VP seat; the MPR plenary vote was moved to 9 December.
events.key_numbers: MPR plenary 9 Dec 2026 (moved from 2 Dec) · Dasco, Muzani and Sugiono named in the VP shortlist
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia is about to pick a new vice president for the first time mid-term.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler (16 Nov) #1, #3, #8, #14; CNBC Indonesia news #17; CNN Indonesia analysis

events.event: A joint team found 74 illegal gold-mining pits and cyanide ponds inside Gunung Halimun Salak National Park, and the pits were closed.
events.key_numbers: 74 illegal pits · cyanide ponds found · Taman Nasional Gunung Halimun Salak
events.why_it_matters: Cyanide from illegal mines near Jakarta's water catchments is a health and environment risk, and ties into Prabowo's push against illegal mining.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia and detik both ran it; also Kapolri vows to crack down on illegal mining (CNBC Indonesia news #16)

events.event: BMKG recorded an M5.8 earthquake at sea about 45 km northeast of Ruteng, Manggarai, NTT, felt as far as Sumba, with no tsunami potential.
events.key_numbers: M5.8 · depth about 10 km · 11:41 WIB 18 Nov 2026 · 8.21S 120.55E · 17 aftershocks by 12:30 WIB, largest M4.9 · intensity IV-V MMI in Manggarai · no damage or casualties reported
events.why_it_matters: A shallow quake in the Flores back-arc zone; BMKG says tectonic stress there still needs watching.

events.event: A PPSDM Migas oil refinery in Cepu, Blora, Central Java exploded around 10:30 WIB; police said it was empty and being cleaned, with leftover gas as a possible cause.
events.key_numbers: about 10:30 WIB 18 Nov 2026 · cause unconfirmed · no casualties mentioned in the first report
events.why_it_matters: A fresh industrial accident at a state energy training refinery; official confirmation from ESDM is still pending.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia News section, single outlet so far

events.event: Kemenhub's pre-Nataru ramp check led to 697 buses being banned from operating over safety failures.
events.why_it_matters: Affects anyone planning to travel by bus over Christmas and New Year; tells you how to check if your bus is licensed.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia Latest #2; Antara also covers Nataru ticket stimulus

events.event: Social Affairs Minister Gus Ipul and Cak Imin addressed the Sekolah Rakyat plan near UI's Hutan Kota: Cak Imin said it will not be built in the Hutan Kota UI, while Mensos urged Brebes SRT 1 parents to pledge not to withdraw.
events.why_it_matters: A reversal on a controversial school site, plus signs of parents pulling kids out of Sekolah Rakyat.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA Terpopuler (Hutan Kota UI item); CNN Indonesia video and article

events.event: OTT (sting) arrests a BPK auditor and a PDAM official in Bengkayang, both named suspects; KPK also responded to Raffi Ahmad's statement that he consulted KPK in 2024 and urged Kemenbud and KKP to review influencer service contracts.
events.key_numbers: 2 suspects (BPK auditor and PDAM official) · Details of influencer contract values not verified
events.why_it_matters: A state auditor caught in a bribery sting, and government spending on influencers under KPK scrutiny.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA Top News #1 (Raffi Ahmad); CNN Indonesia nasional list

events.event: BNPB data showed 1,468 karhutla hotspots nationally with Papua Selatan hotspots up 66 percent, as Prabowo apologised to Malaysia and Singapore over haze at the ASEAN summit.
events.key_numbers: 1,468 hotspots · Papua Selatan +66% · 935 hotspots in East Kalimantan (Kutai Timur most) · date of the 1,468 figure not confirmed
events.why_it_matters: Haze is now a diplomatic issue and keeps hitting air quality in Jakarta and Kalimantan.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler (16 Nov) #9; Papua figure dates from 6 Nov, so check recency
